1.consolidated_definition: Referido a persona, dormida profundamente, boca arriba, con brazos y piernas abiertas, como una penca.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Referring to a person, deeply asleep, lying on their back, with arms and legs spread wide, resembling a bunch of bananas.
